title: csyncmer_fast: an efficient single-threaded C implementation of closed syncmer extraction
description: A header-only C library for fast extraction of closed syncmers, using AVX2 SIMD with a two-stack sliding-window minimum and a rolling ntHash. Provides canonical and non-canonical variants, count-only and position-collecting entry points, a scalar fallback for platforms without AVX2, and an exact 64-bit streaming iterator.
